question: How is the tāmasa lord of the other world characterized in relation to dharma?
premises: A tāmasa lord of the other world is named.
That outer aspect is identified as dharma.
inference: The outer tāmasa lord of the other world is identified as dharma.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation among the nominatives is compressed and open to interpretation.
plain_english: The tāmasa lord of the other world is outer; that is dharma, the lord.
